issues.where: sunlit ocean tiles, storm wall and lower blue water
issues.what: the water is a combed plastic sheet with no glitter, and the cloud edges are airbrushed noise stretched along the flow
issues.fix: give the ocean a Fresnel glint and break the cloud streaks into clumpy, shadowed cells

issues.where: top left tile, storm and white bands
issues.what: the bands are flat, smeared strokes with no cloud-top shadow, so the deck reads as paint
issues.fix: add self-shadow and uneven clump scale so the streaks are not one combed layer

issues.what: the disc is soft and nearly featureless, with no crater rims, so it fails at native size
issues.fix: restore small crater relief and keep the lit face from going featureless white

issues.what: the faint clouds are a smudged fade with almost no structure
issues.fix: keep a little high cloud structure in the shadow instead of a flat airbrush

issues.where: star just outside the upper right limb
issues.what: the core is a few pixels wide with a purple fringe, not a clean point
issues.fix: keep bright stars to one or two pixels and drop the colored halo

issues.where: crops N and O, near cloud bank
issues.what: The brightest clouds are soft white folds with long, combed strands and little internal shading. At native size the bank reads as a smeared ribbon rather than a volume.
issues.fix: Break the strands into irregular volumes at several scales and restore self-shadowing and fine detail in the bright cores.

issues.where: crop A around the storm eye and crops G and I toward the horizon
issues.what: The blue surface has a nearly uniform etched grain that hooks sharply around the eye and stretches into parallel streaks toward the horizon.
issues.fix: Vary the grain by scale and direction, reduce the tight warp around the eye, and filter the fine detail as it recedes.

issues.where: crops C, E and I, ring arcs
issues.what: The rings resolve into uniformly soft blue bands, with bright background stars staying similarly prominent through the densest streaks and through the gaps.
issues.fix: Give the bands finer radial structure and use the ring density to modulate star transmission.

issues.where: crops Q and R, moon at the far right
issues.what: The moon has an evenly blurred limb and a pink cap with faint, pulled-out streaks but little readable surface relief.
issues.fix: Resolve the limb more cleanly and add fine, irregular albedo and relief on the lit cap without sharpening the terminator into a hard line.

issues.where: crops C and F, just under the bright horizon
issues.what: A narrow blue-violet line runs parallel to the bright rim and reads as a second outline rather than a continuous falloff.
issues.fix: Blend the inner color transition into the atmospheric falloff while keeping the silhouette defined.
